issues.description: Unique index expression uses ((created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date) instead of (created_at::date) as specified in plan. Functionally equivalent (TIMESTAMPTZ cast defaults to session timezone which is UTC), and arguably more robust. Not a correctness issue.

strengths: All IF NOT EXISTS guards present — idempotent re-runs safe
workspace_settings uses CREATE TABLE (not ALTER) as required
All FK relationships have proper ON DELETE clauses (CASCADE for ownership, SET NULL for optional references)
Partial indexes use correct WHERE clauses for performance
Consistent with existing schema.sql patterns (comment blocks, indentation, constraint naming)

issues.description: AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' in the unique index is technically a spec deviation (spec says bare ::date), though functionally equivalent and a defensive improvement.
